text: Lady Moonberry is a faerie located in Ardenweald and a prominent member of the Court of Night. She appears to hold significant authority among the Night Fae Covenant, often seen acting on the Winter Queen's behalf and organizing the defense of Ardenweald when her queen and Lord Herne are not available. She has the power to grant mortals the power of the fae, fights with magic, and can summon illusions called Misty Allies to aid her. Despite her position, Moonberry is typically a kind and playful soul. She enjoys pulling lighthearted pranks and organizing plays at the Star Lake Amphitheater. Moonberry is first seen in Journey to Ardenweald and is an important character in both the Ardenweald

Fyldren Moonfeather was a night elf hippogryph flight master located in the original Feathermoon Stronghold of Feralas. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having been killed in the naga attack on old Feathermoon Stronghold, and has been replaced by Irela Moonfeather on the new Feathermoon Stronghold.

Jode was a brilliant Ironforge dwarf tinker with big plans for the future. He wanted to explore the mountains with his henchman, Chava, looking for arcanite deposits. He needed a flying machine to leapfrog ahead of his claim-jumping competition. The young dwarf wanted to head to the mountains in a few weeks. Not feeling the need to rush things, Jode decided that he didn't need the fastest flying machine possible (he knew he could always upgrade the copter later). He figured that sixty miles an hour was fast enough. Jode came up with a design, in which the flying machine had the primary task to "fly around in comfort and style." According to his plans, it would be able to travel up to sixty m

Dungar Longdrink is a human gryphon flight master located in the Gryphon Roost in Stormwind City. He is the main flightmaster for the city. He can be found near Bralla Cloudwing and Tannec Stonebeak. When the Alliance established its garrison at Lunarfall on the alternate Draenor, Dungar joined to serve as flight master.

Feathermoon Stronghold was the name of the night elf island fortress located off the western coast of Feralas on Sardor Isle on the continent of Kalimdor. It had a hippogryph point and could be reached from Auberdine, Nijel's Point and Thalanaar. The stronghold was established by General , who for the past ten thousand years has been 's right hand in the Sentinels. Feathermoon was most easily accessible by a boat taken from Feralas in the Forgotten Coast to an island dock, though many Alliance players who didn't like to wait for the boat preferred to swim.

Flynn Fairwind is a human from Kul Tiras. A former pirate captain, he now serves the interests of Kul Tiras as long as he gets paid. He is the captain of the Middenwake and the Bold Arva. Flynn styles himself as a charismatic and dashing rogue, with seedy contacts throughout Tiragarde Sound and a talent for improvising to turn a bad situation around. However, he has a habit of being captured or humiliated and needing to be bailed out by his friends, typically the adventurer or Taelia Fordragon. Still, Flynn remains a loyal and honest friend, as well as an asset to the Alliance. Flynn serves as the Alliance manager for island expeditions, and a major character in the Tiragarde Sound storyline

Lynessa Sunsorrow is a blood elf found underground. Lynessa's a former Blood Knight. After they stopped draining power from the Naaru, she left the order disgusted. She felt that the elves had grown weak and that drawing from the Sunwell couldn't give her the power she truly sought. Now starving for magic, she's come to the Catacombs, a repository of ancient energy. As she explores, she drains the magic from the air, feasting for the first time since she left Silvermoon.
Magistrix Nizara is a blood elf quartermaster for Silvermoon City and is located in Eversong Woods near Skymistress Gloaming, the flight master for Silvermoon City.

Mavrana Mooncrest was a Grand Magistrix and ruling princess of Suramar prior to the War of the Ancients. She owned a magical crown which conveyed large amounts of arcane power and allowed her to achieve almost unlimited mastery of magic. The crown's power stemmed from the Jewels of Aellis which adorned it. Mavrana's own fate is not stated. During the War of the Ancients, her crown was stolen by rival nobles who removed and sold its jewels. The crown was later recovered and is now displayed in the Midnight Court. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, adventurers working with the Reliquary recovered the Jewels of Aellis from around Suramar, but found that they had been drained of th

Silas Darkmoon is the founder and leader of the Darkmoon Faire, an exotic bunch of wandering showmen, who together celebrate the wondrous and mysterious idiosyncrasies found in Azeroth. Previously operating in Mulgore and Elwynn Forest, his Faire has since the time of Deathwing's fall moved to Darkmoon Island. Silas Darkmoon announces corn dog eating contests.

Tess Undertide is a Kul Tiran human first seen in the Darkmoon Faire on the Darkmoon Island. She had traveled to the island to learn the ways of warlocks from Madam Shadow and was learning from Madam Shadow's grimoire about summoning imps through ritual circles, but she kept failing, even with the assistance of Initiate Darkleaf. She briefly expressed doubts that she should have become a Tidesage, like her father. Later, with the other initiates, Tess was witnessing Madam Shadow's rituals. After Madam Shadow was revealed to be Lord Banehollow and the dreadlord was defeated, Tess met with the surviving initiates in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. She came to call herself imp slayer.

Topper McNabb is a human beggar and former farmer, located in the Trade District of Stormwind City, just up the alley behind the Auction House. He can also be found on the Darkmoon Island, at the pier on the southernmost point of the island, begging for coins. When the Uncrowned and the Veiled Hand infiltrated the city and caused lockdown, McNabb was seen sleeping in the Auction House. In the Vision of Stormwind, Topper is transformed into a rat and once he is killed he reverts back to his human form. The talking cat Tiddles will then begin eating the corpse.

Raelas Firewind is a night elf located in Lushdream Crags in the Emerald Dream. He is a druid equipped with enough firepower to burn the area to ash. Shandris Feathermoon was assigned to help Keeper Sillas with Raelas. She asked Lilian Voss for help. They found out that he manipulated the flame dryads to bind spirits from the Dream to magical spirit stones. With his blessing, the stones became powerful tools of corruption, allowing the fallen dryads to twist the Dream and its denizens. The duo cornered Raelas and asked the adventurer for aid. They defeated his dryad minions and collected the stones. Then, they went to attack Raelas, and his fire magic overwhelmed him, leaving behind nothing

Elune is a moon goddess of the cosmic realm of Life. Her sister and counterpart is the Winter Queen, one of the Eternal Ones of Death. Together, they embody the balance of the great cycle of Life and Death. Elune is worshipped by several mortal cultures throughout the Great Dark Beyond, on both Azeroth and other planets. On Azeroth, she is best known as the primary goddess of the night elves, whom she considers her "favored children". She is associated with the larger of the planet's two moons, the White Lady, and is considered to be the mother of Cenarius, the forest lord and patron god of all druids. Reverence for Elune is not limited to the night elves, however. In tauren culture, she is

Empress Zoe was a little known Dark Iron dwarf ruler of the Dark Iron clan with an obsession with dragons. Many dwarves lost their lives humoring her obsession by attempting to steal dragon eggs or young. A pair of powerful magical rings bear Zoe's name: The Word of Empress Zoe and the Oath of Empress Zoe. The Word was at some point shattered and thus stripped of its magical properties, whereas the Oath was lost and can be found deep within the Halls of Reflection.

Franklin Jenner is a deceased human on Darkmoon Island. His ghost is located just to the west of the Faire and is only visible while dead. He is one of several ghosts on the island. According to Franklin, he was a veteran of the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and Horde. He claims that many have died by his hands and he wanted to leave the horrors of war behind him. He sought out the Darkmoon Faire for this purpose and was promised he'd never have to encounter the horrors he witnessed when serving under the Alliance banner. Unfortunately, Franklin's life was brought to an end at the Faire. The cause of his death remains unknown.

Han'al was a mage of the Kirin Tor and their Master Lorekeeper. He had written and compiled a tome of great and dangerous knowledge which he called Magic & Mayhem. The book held paths to unknown power, containing lore about magic, classes, magical items, weapons, and constructs. He warned people to be careful not to allow the book to lead them to feelings that the world was theirs to conquer. He warned that such delusions would lead only to ruin.
Innkeeper Velandra is a blood elf innkeeper located in Silvermoon City Inn between the Royal Exchange and Murder Row in Silvermoon City.
Jessica Rogers is a human Darkmoon Faire game operator located at Darkmoon Island, which is only available during the monthly Darkmoon Faire event.

Lor'danel is a seaside night elf settlement in northern Darkshore. Unlike the rest of Darkshore, the ground and trees here are vibrant green. Lor'danel features an inn, a flight path, and a moonwell. Despite its coastal location, the town has no dock; instead, it is connected to Rut'theran Village by a flight path, which is automatically known by night elves upon character creation and learned by other Alliance characters by visiting either the Lor'danel or Rut'theran Village flight master.

Lorekeeper Vaeldrin was a night elf who sought to restore his people's immortality. Having found some scrolls that predated even Queen Azshara, Vaeldrin convinced Tyrande Whisperwind to approve his mission to find a power that would grant them eternal life once more. Tyrande at first did not approve of the mission, but after she received a vision in which she saw a light that needed to be defended, she appointed Lyalia to lead Sentinels and accompany Vaeldrin into the new-found continent. After he opened a portal to a place of a secret power, his team ended up in the Krasarang Wilds, where they were caught in a mogu trap which siphoned life force, much like a warlock siphons life off their v
Magic Suppression is a Death knight talent located in the 4th tier of the Unholy Tree. If this talent is maxed out, the Death Knight ability Anti-Magic Shell will absorb 100% of magic damage.

Magister Xintar is a night elf mage who specializes in portal magic. He accompanies Sentinel Lyalia and Lorekeeper Vaeldrin in their quest through Krasarang Wilds. His magical abilities were sundered somewhat when he was caught in a Mogu trap, also causing him to not be able to stand up straight. He later moved to the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. After Garrosh Hellscream unleashed the sha in the vale, Xintar moved before the shrine helping the Golden Lotus warriors to defend the place. He can also be seen on the Timeless Isle overlooking the Celestial Court with Ella. He dares not to create a portal on the isle.
Mola is an orc Darkmoon Faire game operator located at Darkmoon Island, which is only available during the monthly Darkmoon Faire event.

Moon Priestess Lasara is a night elf priestess and quartermaster for Darnassus located west of the Temple Gardens in Darnassus, next to the portal to Rut'theran Village. Moon Priestess Lasara survived the Burning of Teldrassil and made her way to Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. Later she participates in the Battle for Darkshore, manning the Altar of Elders in Bashal'Aran. Lasara was present in Bashal'Aran and witnessed Tyrande's speech about Horde's defeat in Darkshore. Moon Priestess Lasara appears in the Central Encampment under Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream, acting as a vendor for the Dream Wardens.

Morgan Pestle is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found in the shop Pestle's Apothecary, which he is the owner of. He is the brother of William Pestle, who is also an alchemist, in Goldshire. He can be briefly seen among concerned citizens during the city's lockdown when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city during the Burning Legion's third invasion His dead body appears in the Vision of Stormwind, next to Morgan's Notes.

Nikkle was a female mage. There are no official records of a mage of Dalaran by her name. Many mages deny her existence because she used magic for an unthinkable reason: She had fun with it. She had no desire to use magic for offense or even defense; she preferred to delight children with her skills. She had the skill to make powerful magic items, and still used them only as an act. As she was drummed out of Dalaran before the Scourge came, no one knows where she is. All that's left of her questionable legacy is a piece of black silk about eight feet square, Nikkle's Fabulous Silken Cloth.

Pai Stormbringer is the mortal co-leader of the Cult of the Damned, in collaboration with Ul'haik Hadanot. She is short and pudgy, and is surprisingly fast and flexible for her size. Pai was once an assassin working for the corrupt nobles of the Alterac Mountains and later for the Syndicate. She later felt the call of the Lich King and joined the Cult in the early days of the Third War. She was promised a way to combine dark magic and her assassination skills, and later showed a powerful skill in bringing new recruits into the Cult. With her honeyed voice and her staggering looks, she attracts weak-willed persons to whom she promises power and wealth to if they serve the Cult. If they find t
Phillipe is a human located at Darkmoon Faire on the Darkmoon Island. He is riding a Darkmoon Pony in the Petting Zoo.

Priest Ennas is a blood elf found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. He can be seen preaching to many other blood elves while standing next to Lyria Skystrider. The pair protest the excessive use of magic, insult Lor'themar Theron's choice to ally Silvermoon with the Horde, and brand the magisters as traitors to Quel'Thalas. After three magisters in the crowd he is preaching to summon Priest Kath'mar, Priest Ennas and Lyria Skystrider are both the targets of a mind-control spell. Their speech reverses direction, as they exclaim that the Alliance will pay for their betrayal and the Horde will bring the blood elves back to their former glory.

Rarthein is a blood elf who wanders around Silvermoon City. His routine involves walking from Wayfarer's Rest through the Bazaar to General Goods, talking to Sathren Azuredawn. Then, he continues to the Priest Ennas and Lyria Skystrider forum, briefly observing the crowd. Rarthein then goes back to the tavern where he proceeds to check all the barrels. This might give a clue to his occupation in the city.

Royal Factor Bathrilor is a human located in the City Hall of Stormwind City. He is responsible for all censuses taken within the city of Stormwind for at least the last five years, and maintains the city's population records, only accessible through 'arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline'. He can be found on the second floor of the building, which is located in the Cathedral Square, just east of the Cathedral of Light.

Saviana Ragefire is a member of the Black dragonflight and a mini boss. She appears in World of Warcraft as one of the three sub-bosses in the Ruby Sanctum. In order to shatter the Wyrmrest Accord and to crush those that would stand in the way of their master's reemergence into Azeroth, a powerful war party of the Black dragonflight; led by the fearsome twilight dragon Halion and his lieutenants Saviana Ragefire, Baltharus the Warborn and General Zarithrian; has launched an assault upon the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.

Shadow Covenant is a Discipline priest talent. It is a powerful instant heal that strengthens Shadow damage and healing, while turning Divine Star, Halo, and Penance into Divine Star (Shadow), Halo (Shadow), and Dark Reprimand.

Shattered Restoration is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from Kin-Tara in the Spires of Ascension, Lady Inerva Darkvein in Castle Nathria, and Soulrender Dormazain in the Sanctum of Domination. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthen the Bond, A Journey Made Together, Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae), and Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).

Tassia Whisperglen is a high elf stable master found inside the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran. After the Purge of Dalaran, she accompanied Kirin Tor Offensive on the Isle of Thunder, traveling on the Seabolt and landing on the Violet Rise. Tassia was seen in Dalaran above the Deadwind Pass where she accounted for the menagerie's animals. When the city was teleported to the Broken Isles, she resumed her stable master duties. She was briefly seen speaking with Grif Wildheart. She is later seen aboard the Vindicaar.

Teleportologist Fozlebub is a gnome mage found fishing on the shore near the Darkmoon Boardwalk on Darkmoon Island. He offers a quick travel option back to Maxima Blastenheimer and the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon for a price, that varies by the character's level.

Thalanaar was a tiny Alliance night elf camp on the border of Feralas and the Thousand Needles, until the flooding of the Needles by the Cataclysm destroyed the area. The outpost had very little to offer in the way of goods and services, although it was the location for the Tribal Leatherworking trainer Caryssia Moonhunter and had a flight path that could be reached from Feathermoon Stronghold, Theramore Isle, and Gadgetzan. New Thalanaar was constructed immediately to the west.

Ur was a mage of Dalaran before the coming of the Scourge. He was best known for his studies on shadow magic and his research on other worlds. He is most well known for his research on the alien creatures known as worgen. Though his knowledge was great, some believed that his conscience held him from true power. He died during the Siege of Dalaran at the hands of the Scourge. One of his books, The Book of Ur, was held in Shadowfang Keep by Archmage Arugal. The dark mage, Morganth also possessed a book written by Ur, Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic, which the mages of Stormwind City wanted returned to them because they feared that Morganth might find a way to open it and read its contents.
Avara is a blood elf located in the Murder Row in Silvermoon City. She works under Belath Dawnblade on uncovering fel magic in the city.

Beregos was a member of the blue dragonflight who served as the archlibrarian of the Azure Archives. Beregos worked with Sindragosa to create an army of illusions to make the borders of the Broodlands appear far more defended than they were, and later on was a principle architect behind the Molten Abyss: a gambit where the blue dragonflight used their illusory magics to lure the Primalist forces underground for the black dragonflight to bury alive.

Priest Ennas is a blood elf found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. He can be seen preaching to many other blood elves while standing next to Lyria Skystrider. The pair protest the excessive use of magic, insult Lor'themar Theron's choice to ally Silvermoon with the Horde, and brand the magisters as traitors to Quel'Thalas. After three magisters in the crowd he is preaching to summon Priest Kath'mar, Priest Ennas and Lyria Skystrider are both the targets of a mind-control spell. Their speech reverses direction, as they exclaim that the Alliance will pay for their betrayal and the Horde will bring the blood elves back to their former glory. Years later, as Ennas the Faithfallen relocated to T

Galok Wingslicer was the djaradin general, who led the siege on the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream, seeking to take control of it in order to pervert the nature and stunt the growth of Amirdrassil, which was being nourished by the Eye's power. During this siege, the djaradin summoned a fiery orb of shadowflame, the magic of which threatened to overwhelm the Eye, though the green dragons were able to create a magic barrier to temporarily defend against it. Scouting then revealed that Galok had help from two other powerful djaradin, the Anvil and Moltenbinder, and that Igira had supplied his troops with suffused weapons. Not having the resources to attack the djaradin in their base, the dra

Nolizdormu is a member of the bronze dragonflight. His egg was among the primal dragon eggs that were stolen from their nests by the titan-forged under the orders of the dragonflights, and he had attempted to look through the timeways to uncover the truth behind his lack of parents and strange memories of being ordered but Sirigosa believed that whatever he saw was not what had truly happened. He was a close friend of Talinstrasz and when the red drake began to foment dissent against the dragonflights in favor of the Primalist cause upon learning about the flights' theft of primal eggs, Nolizdormu was among the drakes he gathered and among the few who stayed to listen. This led to his defect
Silvermoon Guard Captain is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. Along with a pair of Silvermoon Guards, they escort Kul'amara the Fierce.

Strength is a general stat in Xenoblade Chronicles. Generally speaking, the higher a character's strength, the more damage will be done by their auto-attacks and physical arts. Strength can be increased through skills, gems, arts buffs, and leveling up. High strength is very useful for characters like Reyn and Dunban, whose arts are mostly physical. It is less useful for characters like Melia and Sharla, whose arts are mostly Ether-based. __NOTOC__

Drisella was an orc who appeared at the entrance to the Sewer in Shattered Halls. She was imprisoned in Kargath Bladefist's prison but was able to escape. She asked Horde adventurers to rescue Captain Boneshatter from execution, noting that his death could be a huge blow to the Horde forces in Outland. She only appeared to Horde players when Shattered Halls was played in Heroic mode.

Empower Rune Weapon is a death knight talent that allows the death knight to empower their rune weapon, increasing their haste and runic power generation. Frost death knights can take this talent twice to gain an extra charge.

Faldar Willowshade is a night elf vendor located at the refreshments table at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island. He sells various draughts and tinctures for each. The only difference between the two types is the manner in which they affect character size.

Fatigue is a condition that affects any character travelling through or over water that is too deep, such as the oceans surrounding the continents. Close to land, the ocean floor is generally not very far below sea level, and it can usually be seen from the surface; at greater distances from the shore, the floor recedes deeper and deeper. When the depth of the water reaches a certain point, swimming in the region causes a Fatigue bar to appear, which displaying a player's weariness. It behaves similar to the Breath bar; the bar will deplete over time (the Fatigue bar depletes much faster than the Breath bar, it matches the rate at which the Breath bar originally depleted), and will deal dama

Felfire Haste is a conduit for demon hunters. It drops from the Stone Legion Generals in Castle Nathria, Grand Proctor Beryllia in the Sanguine Depths, and Fatescribe Roh-Kalo in the Sanctum of Domination. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthen the Bond, A Journey Made Together, Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae), and Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).

Flameglow is a mage talent available at level 30. Flameglow is a passive ability, providing a permanent damage reduction on all incoming attacks based on the mage's spell power. It will passively absorb the lesser of 0.3 × SpellPower or 0.2 × AttackDamage damage.

Garyl is an orc tabard vendor located in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. Before the Shattering, she was located in the Horde Embassy. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore she appeared at the Dranosh'ar Blockade. After the battle, she could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. She was also present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Gelanthis is a blood elf jewelcrafting vendor located in Silvermoon Jewelery in the Royal Exchange in Silvermoon City.

Halion is a twilight dragon. He is the main boss of the Ruby Sanctum, which was implemented in patch 3.3.5. In order to shatter the Wyrmrest Accord and to crush those that would stand in the way of their master's reemergence into Azeroth, a powerful war party of the Black dragonflight; led by the fearsome twilight dragon Halion and his lieutenants Saviana Ragefire, Baltharus the Warborn and General Zarithrian; has launched an assault upon the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple. Halion was raised in captivity from the eggs created by Sinestra.

Horran Redmane is a Wildhammer dwarf in the 7th Legion. He succeeded General Marstone after his death, and was later sent to aid in the defense of Theramore Isle. When Theramore's North Gate fell, after being weakened by Thalen Songweaver, Horran joined other members of the Alliance in personally fighting against Warchief Garrosh Hellscream. When Garrosh and the rest of the Horde retreated, Horran, like most of Theramore's defenders, thought they had won. He was killed when Hellscream ordered the mana bomb, empowered by the Focusing Iris, dropped on Theramore which destroyed the city.

Hurley Blackbreath is an elite Dark Iron dwarf hiding in the Grim Guzzler bar inside of Blackrock Depths. Both Ragnar Thunderbrew and Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave would like the ale recipe that Hurley stole. In order to get his attention so that you get the recipe, you have to destroy the thing most precious to him (well, and maybe to you too)--the large kegs of brew. When you first enter the bar through the steps, take a left and you'll find an empty room with some kegs you can destroy. You'll destroy three of these and Blackbreath will come running in with some cronies who are also in a very bad mood now.

Jago was one of the human attendants at the Gathering in the Arathi Highlands. During the event, he reunited with the now-Forsaken Wilmer, whom he called "my Wilmer [...] the best man I ever knew and loved". Their reunion ended in tragedy when Wilmer and the other members of the Desolate Council were killed on the orders of Sylvanas Windrunner. Jago was left devastated by the event. By the end of the Fourth War, he was drunk, homeless, penniless, and taking shelter in a barn belonging to a farmer and his son near Saldean's Farm in Westfall. Without the farmers' permission, he used the barn to brew moonshine, eventually causing an explosion that destroyed the building's roof. King Anduin Wryn

Koristrasza is a red dragon found in Razorfen Downs. She appears near the entrance after players zone in. She first arrived here after the Cataclysm. Since the war in Draenor, she returned to the Downs once again as the phylactery of Amnennar wasn't destroyed. As a dragon she battled against the Death Speaker Blackthorn who was working on a way to bring the lich back. When the quilboar was killed, Amnennar rose once again. After the lich was killed, his phylactery was taken by Koristrasza to the red dragonflight to find a way to destroy the object.
Larissia is a blood elf guild vendor found at the Silvermoon Registry in Silvermoon City.
Lelorian is a blood elf inscription supplies vendor found in the Court of the Sun in Silvermoon City. Lelorian stands near Zantasia, Master Inscription Trainer and the Lexicon of Power.

Liam is a human living in a farm who always wanted to study magic. Once, his dad told him he could go to Stormwind as soon as he separates good and bad potatoes. Instead he went out with his friends. Heading to Stormwind they decided to go fishing. While fishing along the shore with his two friends Jimmy Blackridge and Bram Woodring, he and his friends were abducted and found themselves unwilling crew members for the Bloodsail Buccaneers. The Bloodsail Buccaneers taught the three boys how to fight. Dual daggers was Liam's weapon of choice. While on Plunder Isle, Liam found some magic scrolls and tomes from their looting and learned from them to become proficient at magic. Under the command o

Lion's Commander is a human who operates the The Lion's Roar in the Arathi Highlands. After the war machine is destroyed, the commander teleports himself away. He later operated The Indomitable in Dazar'alor during the Battle of Dazar'alor, but after it was destroyed the commander died in the explosion.

Lothrius Mooncaller is a night elf located in Suramar, one of the few Moon Guard survivors of the Nightborne's attack upon the Moon Guard Stronghold. After narrowly escaping, he, Thalrenus Rivertree, and Syrana Starweaver were invited to Shal'Aran by Thalyssra, who sought to atone for Elisande's crimes against their ancient neighbors, and they subsequently actively assisted the Nightfallen rebellion in Meredil.

Lucan Cordell is a human artisan enchanting trainer found inside his enchanting shop Cordell's Enchanting in the Canals in Stormwind City. He appears to be the most senior and skilled enchanter in the city, serving as the Royal Enchanter for King Varian Wrynn himself, and is known for being commissioned to create powerful staves for those heroes who have proven themselves worthy.

Lyria Skystrider is a blood elf found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. She, along with Priest Ennas, is leading a public forum arguing against the policies of the blood elven leadership, specifically their decision to break off their ties to the Alliance and join the Horde. She proclaims that Sylvanas Windrunner is not the same one that they once knew, the orcs are "fair-weather friends", and the magisters are traitors. After a few minutes, three Silvermoon Magisters in the crowd summon Priest Kath'mar who immediately casts a mind-control spell on Lyria and Ennas, causing their speech to become completely supportive of Lor'themar Theron and the magisters.

Magda Whitewall is a Gilnean human found outside Gilneas City before the Battle of Gilneas City. At the Livery Outpost, she asked an adventurer to gather stag meat to make a final meal for the men. After the reclamation of Gilneas she can be found inside a house in Emberstone Village outside Gilneas City.

Maith'hal is a high elf mage and a member of the Alliance. He owns a staff of arcane missiles. It is simply a quarterstaff combined with a wand of arcane missile. He has much knowledge of the planes and arcana, and is able to decipher scripts. His knowledge of spells includes; detect magic, light, burning hands, protection from evil, frost armor, and mana burn. He was once hired by Molus Blackburn (who had been in disguise) to break into the lair of the necromancer Toren Snapjoint and destroy him. He was hired along with fellow Alliance members, including Widge Whistlevalve, Botrek Pahno, Cerise Moonrain, Jarlath Brewbelly, and Yinny. After battling Toren, his acolytes and his undead servant

Mannoroth was the barbaric leader of the pit lords when Kil'jaeden recruited them. When Archimonde was placed in command of the pit lords, he recognized Mannoroth's value as a brutal, bloodthirsty fighter and made the pit lord his second-in-command. Mannoroth helped lead the Burning Legion in assaults on countless worlds, and led the first invasion of Azeroth. His ruthlessness and vile cunning made him into one of the favored lieutenants of his masters, Archimonde and Kil'jaeden, the champions of the Burning Legion. He is known as "the Destructor" and "the Flayer". In addition to his martial prowess, Mannoroth was a powerful spellcaster. His magical knowledge and power exceeded even the most

Marius Felbane is a night elven demon hunter of the Illidari who can initially be found in various places on Mardum, the Shattered Abyss. He later travels with his partner Tehd Shoemaker to various locations around the Broken Isles, including Azsuna, Highmountain, Stormheim and Val'sharah, to halt the efforts of the Burning Legion and their allies while fighting various powerful demons. Aiding Marius and his partner is the subject of Tehd & Marius' Excellent Adventure. Marius and Tehd share a professional relationship, hating each other and what the other stands for, but acknowledging that they need each other to help fight the Legion. In their efforts, they have fought a giant felbat named

Margrave Gharmal was the leader of the House of Constructs, one of the five Necrolord houses of Maldraxxus. A massive abomination, Gharmal possessed the power to shape flesh in ways that few other beings could. They had a voracious appetite for power and hoarded anything they believed to be an item of power. In the absence of the Primus, Gharmal and their house allied with Margrave Sin'dane of the House of Rituals in an attempt to conquer the Shadowlands, but the abomination margrave was slain in their stronghold by a joint assault by the Kyrian and Necrolord Covenants.

Martha Weller is a deceased human on Darkmoon Island. Her ghost is located by the Spirit Healer and is only visible while dead. She is one of several ghosts on the island. Martha does not provide much detail into her past. However, the details she mentions about what she did at the Faire lend credit to believe she was a caregiver or someone in the medical field in life.

Merchant Fallel Stargazer was a general goods vendor onboard the Moonspray, the boat that ran between Auberdine and Rut'theran Village before the Cataclysm. He sold anything you could possibly need, and also repaired gear. Though the Moonspray stopped sailing after the Cataclysm, Fallel returned to aid in the Battle for Darkshore. As of Dragonflight, Fallel is seen standing in the main building of Belanaar, Amirdrassil.

Moonclaw Vale is a night elf village found in Val'sharah. The druids of Moonclaw Vale were the protectors of Val'sharah, warding off any threat who would seek to disrupt the balance of nature. Their leader and instructor is Thaon Moonclaw, Archdruid of the Vale. Unfortunately, the satyrs have awoken, and the Emerald Nightmare has penetrated the village, corrupting it. The village is filled with the corpses of night elf druids and is currently under attack. Two satyr leaders live here, Xandris the Dishonored and Kagraxxis the Corruptor. They both fought in the War of the Ancients.

Morev was a human guard commander in the Capital City. He told King Terenas Menethil that the city was going to be invaded by the Horde. He was a seasoned veteran Terenas knew since his youth. When the orcs attacked the city, Morev killed an orc who was about to attack Terenas. It is unknown whether he survived the Second or Third War.

Narkrall Rakeclaw is a Dragonmaw orc located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands. He is the carrier of the Demon Chain, an artifact that once carried the Demon Soul and which still holds some of its power, most notable the power to control the minds of dragons, which is seen when it was used by Narkrall to enslave members of the black dragonflight.

Officer Pomeroy is a human officer in the Stormwind City Guard. He can be found patrolling the streets of the Trade District and Mage Quarter in the human capital of Stormwind City, one of several agents to do so. He assisted the other guards when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.
Olrokk is an orc wyvern riding trainer located near the wyvern stables at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley. He provides the training to allow Horde players to ride flying mounts.

Priestess Alathea is a night elf priest trainer located in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She was involved in teaching priests their race-specific abilities, until they were removed. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she treated a Desperate Darnassian Citizen. Ultimately, she refused to leave the Temple of the Moon. It is not known whether she survived the burning or not.

Priest Kath'mar is a blood elf found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. He is summoned by three Silvermoon Magisters at a forum led by Lyria Skystrider and Priest Ennas who are arguing against the policies of the blood elven leadership that have broken ties to the Alliance and placed them on the side of the Horde. As soon as he appears, he casts a mind-control spell on Lyria and Ennas, causing their speech to change and now support Lor'themar Theron and the magisters. He then despawns.

Readiness is a hunter talent. When activated, it immediately finishes the cooldowns on most other hunter abilities. It has no effect on pet abilities such as Roar of Recovery or Call of the Wild (pet ability).
Sellandus is a night elf located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. He was briefly seen in Trader's Hall when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Shanna is a proud, and seemingly slightly mad, mage. Shanna is also a charismatic and inspiring speaker. She was responsible for recruiting many magi to her cause, which why so many of them have joined the defectors. She was sent to the traitor city of Theramore to assassinate Jaina Proudmoore during a wedding reception. When the attempt failed, instead killing Staa Stonetouch and a guard, she grabbed the murder weapon, a dragon statue and teleported away from the wedding reception. She was not alone in her zeal: More defectors lay in wait in the city, prepared to strike at any time.

Shattrath Saul is a human located inside World's End Tavern of the Lower City in Shattrath City who announces the upcoming performance of Perry Gatner and The Tauren Chieftains a few minutes in advance. He also occasionally travels around Lower City, advertising about the tavern itself.

Shimra is an orc trade goods vendor located in Orgrimmar General Store in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, she and some other inhabitants of the city were held captive by the Kor'kron. She had to follow Mojka into battle but apparently survived as she is still in Orgrimmar. After the failed Battle for Broken Shore, she moved to the entrance of the shop and was seen talking with an Orgrimmar Grunt.
Silvermoon Magistrix is a blood elf located in Pathfinder's Den in Orgrimmar. She and a Silvermoon Magister are maintaining the Portal to Silvermoon.

Starshards was one of the priest racial abilities available only to Night elf priests. It was a potent Arcane-based instant damage over time spell that could be used by night elf priests and priestesses to rain starshards down upon their foes. It was a lesser version of the powerful Starfall spell which is commonly used by Priestesses of the Moon such as Tyrande Whisperwind.

Suzetta Gallina is a human located in the Gallina Winery in the Canal District of Stormwind City. She is a member of the wine selling Gallina family, who own the shop. Her job within the shop is unclear, but she might run it. She was briefly seen among concerned citizens in the Canals when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Teralygos is an older blue dragon and that was sympathetic to Arygos' stance of isolationism. He often criticized Kalecgos and the other flights but remained loyal regardless. After the revelation of Arygos' betrayal, he maintained loyalty to Kalecgos. Teralygos, alongside Alagosa and Banagos, sensed and discovered that Veragos and the others, who were to escort the Focusing Iris, went missing. Kalecgos returned to the Nexus after the fall of Theramore and told Teralygos and few others about the current situation. He understood that the blue dragonflight did not fulfill their purpose. When Kalecgos disbanded the blue dragonflight, Teralygos was the last to leave. He flew northeast, leaving K

Teremok was a Shattered Hand orc that once fought against the Alliance in a canyon. He and his brothers defeated them and found the ogre Throgg, the last of the Mahrook clan. Seeing him as a strong warrior, he invited Throgg to the Shattered Hand. Throgg, having lost his clansmen agreed and seeing the orcs as strong as well, agreed. Teremok then used his axe to cut off Throgg's right hand. The Shattered Hand then continued fighting against the Alliance. During one battle, Teremok was killed by five Alliance soldiers. Throgg killed the soldiers, but he missed him as he was his friend and brother.

Thaddus Stoutblow was a Wildhammer dwarf, who succeeded General Thornar Thunderclash after his death, and was later sent to aid in the defense of Theramore Isle. When Theramore's North Gate fell, after being weakened by Thalen Songweaver, Thaddus joined other members of the Alliance in personally fighting against Warchief Garrosh Hellscream. When Garrosh and the rest of the Horde retreated, Thaddus, like most of Theramore's defenders, thought they had won. He was killed when Hellscream ordered the mana bomb, empowered by the Focusing Iris, dropped on Theramore which destroyed the city.

Thoder Windermere was a human mage of the Kirin Tor. He was muscular and scarred, looking more like a warrior than a mage, but was nonetheless one of the deftest spellcasters Jaina Proudmoore had ever met. He accompanied Rhonin to defend Theramore Isle, where he helped Kinndy Sparkshine magically enhance the western gate. Though successful, he was killed when the Horde destroyed the city with a mana bomb.

Trainee Alcor is a blood elf rogue found the Students of Shadow in the Murder Row of Silvermoon City. Along with fellow trainee Firea, he's practicing his abilities under the direction of Instructor Cel.

Ul'haik Hadanot is a high elf and the co-leader of the Cult of the Damned alongside Pai Stormbringer. He is tall for an elf, with a thin frame. His hair and skin has darkened almost to pitch black due to his fevered study of magic. He had been a sequestered and unfriendly mage dedicated only to his studies. He preferred his books over contact with other elves, and did not mourn them when Dalaran fell. Instead of feeling disgust at the invading undead, he felt a sense of awe at their power, and surrendered to them willingly. Kel'Thuzad recognized his ambition and quickly put him in charge of the cult, directing mages within and researching dark magic to further the spread of the undead. He pr

Valaden Silverblade was a high elf sword vendor located in The Arsenal Absolute in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, he and Kerta the Bold defended the shop's entrance with weapons in their hands. He accompanied the Kirin Tor Offensive on the Isle of Thunder as a repairs vendor. When the city appeared above Karazhan and the Legion attacked it, he fought against demons in front of the shop. After the city teleported to Khaz Algar, Silverblade was slain by Nerubians allied with Xal'atath.

Vanthir is a prominent resident and former resistance fighter in the nightborne city of Suramar. A tavern owner by trade, Vanthir would rise to particular importance during the Nightfallen rebellion, during which he acted as a major rebel leader within the city. Throughout the civil war, Vanthir operated the city's Nightfallen base of operations from the Waning Crescent tavern, and also oversaw the distribution of arcwine to the starved populace. Many nightborne would come to depend upon his humanitarian efforts. As the conflict began to shift in the rebels' favor, Grand Magistrix Elisande responded by ordering the destruction of the Waning Crescent and its inhabitants. In the ensuing massac

Vannara was a night elf Sentinel who initially served alongside Delaryn Summermoon under Commander Anaris Windwood in Ashenvale. When Horde rogues attacked night elf outposts throughout Ashenvale, Delaryn and Ferryn raced back to Silverwind Refuge, where Vannara informed them of the situation and that Commander Windwood was out on patrol. Later, when the Horde invaded Ashenvale in full force, Vannara accompanied Delaryn in defending the Falfarren River. However, Vannara was eventually killed when an arrow pierced her throat. As of Dragonflight, she can be seen floating around as a wisp in the city of Bel'Amath, Amirdrassil.
Veteran Gladiator was a human located in Stormwind City and Silvermoon City.

Vexiona is a Void-twisted twilight dragon who led the twilight dragonflight in the attack against Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands, engaging with Alexstrasza and her Vermillion dragons. She had come with a group of other twilight dragonkin with the goal of corrupting Alexstrasza's brood into other twilights, claiming that the fate of all dragonflights was to be "united as one." She attempted, unsuccessfully, to sway the Dragon Queen to her side with promises of power, which Alexstrasza immediately denied and began chasing her down. Kalecgos and an adventurer came to the Redoubt and fought off the invaders. After being defeated, she flew away towards the Wetlands, claiming that, i

Voraxian is a black dragon located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores. He is heavily invested in the past of his flight, and has actively pursued leads on ancestral connections to the history of his flight alongside the Dragonscale Expedition on the Forbidden Reach. His travels eventually led to the elder red dragon, Veritistrasz; whose melancholy was broken by an adventurer, and was willing to answer questions about the black dragonflight before their corruption.
Wallace is a human located at Darkmoon Faire on the Darkmoon Island. He runs around with his friends Bodie and Poot.

Worker Mo'rrisroe is a blood elf in Silvermoon City trying to rebuild it. He is with the Silvermoon Builders Association. Jero'me found wandering under the bridge at the Shepherd's Gate is his minion.

Xiggs Fuselighter's Flyingmachine is the personal flying machine of Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter that he flies to a landing pad on an island in the Ruined Reaches of Azshara to pick up the rubbings of arcane runes from the Ruins of Eldarath.

Zul'ras is a shadow hunter of the Horde. Shadow hunters hold places of honor and authority among the jungle trolls of the Darkspear tribe, and Zul'ras is no exception. His many years of experience and his dedication to the tribe and the future of its people have made him a veritable pillar among his jungle troll brethren. Zul'ras plays the role of advisor, historian, and defender of the ancient ways of the Darkspear tribe. Like other shadow hunters, he is an expert at voodoo magic and shares a special connection to the ancient Loa — the powerful spirits that grant him the power to heal, but also to curse. Zul'ras is a haughty and confident troll who enjoys tormenting weaker foes. When facing

Ada Darkhardt is a human located in the Slaughtered Lamb of Stormwind City. She is secretly working for the death knight Gregory, and goes with him to Caer Darrow and Darkwhisper Gorge in his quest to destroy a demonic artifact. She helps defend Gregory against demonic attackers while he performs a ritual to destroy the artifact, but is killed by Diathorus the Seeker. Her death causes Gregory's concentration to falter, breaking the ritual and allowing the pit lord Azgaloth into the world.

Trainee Alcor is a blood elf rogue found the Students of Shadow in the Murder Row of Silvermoon City. Along with fellow trainee Firea, he's practicing his abilities under the direction of Instructor Cel.

Belanaar is the night elf logistics hub of Amirdrassil, located on the north-central shore of the island. Just onshore to the east is Evenfall Watchtower and the Haven Cascades. A Kaldorei Backpack is at on the middle level of the inn, and next to the docked ship at is a Kaldorei Spyglass. From the northern dock, the Moonlit Rose under the command of Captain Talar Oaktalon provides transportation between Belanaar and Stormglen Village in the Ruins of Gilneas. The western dock is unused, and the ship on the eastern dock is permanently berthed and does not go anywhere. Judging by how most of the named NPCs in Belanaar are the former crew of the Moonspray, that might be what the ship is.

Brood Rings is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He provides the Signet Rings of the Bronze Dragonflight for free. The reputation requirements remain however.
Chief Herbalist Draiser is a blood elf located in Silvermoon Alchemy and Enchants Enhanced in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Daelyn is a blood elf fish vendor located in Silvermoon Harbor in Silvermoon City.

Ignion was a member of the black dragonflight present during Raszageth's assault on the Reach who was forced to withdraw from the battle due to his severe injuries. Instead of seeking out the healers, he ventured into Ikronia's prison and convinced her guards—Endemion and Sandesia—to take to the field as fresh reinforcements while he used what strength he had left to keep their prisoner secured. In his final moments of consciousness, he attempted to convince Ikronia of the error of her ways and told her he believed she could still have a future among the black dragonflight, but would not have one at the side of her brother. He succumbed to his injuries shortly after.

Lailastrasza is a member of the red dragonflight's Ruby Flamebringers. She led a number of efforts against the djaradin encroaching on the dragonflights' territories during the War of the Scaleborn. As a whelp, Lailastrasza spent hours playing with Vyranoth in the Ruby Life Pools, alongside her brother Talinstrasz and their friends Atyrannus and Rygos. The siblings refused to hide during hide-and-seek games, afraid that the eyes in the rocks would steal them away from home again if they were left alone. Years later when her brother made efforts to foment rebellion against the dragonflights after he learned that their eggs had been stolen from primal dragon nests and ordered without their con

Duelist Larenis is a blood elf located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. He used to be a weapon master, and taught Daggers One-handed and Two-handed swords, Bows, and Polearms for (less faction bonus). After Xal'atath attacked the Sunwell, he appeared as Elder Larenis and could be found speaking with Elder Marsilla Dawnstar in Silvermoon City.

Lethka is a former member of the Claws of Vyranoth who has become a fanatical devotee of Fyrakk. Lethka festered with bitterness towards her former commander, Vyranoth, after the Incarnate of Ice departed from the Primalists—believing Vyranoth to have neglected her power, and to have thrown away the pursuit of power in favor of ideals—and although Fyrakk did not trust most of Vyranoth's claws after her betrayal, he continued to trust Lethka. Lethka sought to detonate Cinder Summit in order to destroy the barrier safeguarding the Wellspring of Life from Fyrakk's assault. Confronted at Scorching Chasm by Vyranoth, the Incarnate and an adventurer went to slay her.

Lethias Hollander is a blood elf located in a building named Academics Anonymous underneath the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City. He seems to be using fel magic to flip through pages of a book.

Magister Dawnblaze is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City. She is the leader of the Wardsmiths, an order of Magisters tasked with maintaining Silvermoon's defenses. A decadent but ruthless magister, Dawnblaze has been known to render the services of Murder Row to settle political disputes.

Moraidormi (also called Mori) was a bronze dragon and the sister of Eternus. She died fighting Vexemia, her friend who had been afflicted by the corruption of the black dragonflight, in the Timeless Tunnel in Tanaris. Eternus wanted to save her but was denied, leading Eternus to join the infinite dragonflight. When Nozdormu later set out to understand and mend the rift between the bronze and infinite dragonflights, Eternus showed him the moment of Moraidormi's death; she hoped to rewind time, change the outcome, and prove the infinites' perspective valid. No matter how she tried, however, Moraidormi still died. During Eternus's efforts, Nozdormu saw why exactly Moraidormi died, and he reveal

Obezion is a member of the black dragonflight and the twin brother of Ravia. He and his sister had been stolen from a primal nest before they hatched and infused with Order. Obezion and Ravia saved Talinstrasz's life during the first attack on Wyrmrest Temple. Three moons later they were among the drakes Talinstrasz attempted to sway against the dragonflights with the truth of their possible origins as stolen eggs — Obezion attacked Talinstrasz for his vocal support of Vyranoth and impugnment of Alexstrasza but was interrupted by Lailastrasza's arrival before he could inflict actual harm. Obezion and Ravia fought against the djaradin in the Waking Shores as part of Lailastrasza's group. Afte

Oxoria was a grand proto-dragon matriarch who resided in the southern jungles prior to the War of the Scaleborn. By the end of the war her scales had long since petrified into stone, and she utilized the elemental powers of earth in combat. When news of the dragonflights stealing eggs from primal dragon nests reached Oxoria, she and her brood departed their distant home to join the Primalist cause in Harrowsdeep. Oxoria and her mate participated in the conflict at Cinderfrost Vale, where Oxoria's mate was slain by Levarian — in retaliation, Oxoria took out his eye. Later in the war, Oxoria was sent by Vyranoth to try and seize Raszageth's prison from the forces of the black dragonflight: pri

Ravia is a member of the black dragonflight and the twin sister of Obezion. She and her brother had been stolen from a primal nest before they hatched and infused with Order. She placed Zoltica's ashes in the lava cauldrons of the Obsidian Citadel after the Battle of the Reach. Ravia and Obezion saved Talinstrasz's life during the first attack on Wyrmrest Temple. Three moons later they were among the drakes Talinstrasz attempted to sway against the dragonflights with the truth of their possible origins as stolen eggs. She and her brother fought against the djaradin in the Waking Shores as part of Lailastrasza's group. After one of their efforts had concluded, she wanted to go to the Roasted

Riftwalker Ailaya is a void elf located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. She is a trainee of the Riftwalkers and is accompanied by Riftwalker Tarrowyn and Riftwalker Eiteiri, who train her. While in the city, she briefly spoke with Trader Ba'kril, and she promised him to test his new drink. She and her fellow Riftwalkers then stopped by the market, awaiting the adventurer with the drink sent by Ba'kril. When she tasted it, she felt stronger, but its Void energy briefly knocked her down, much to the disappointment of her trainers, who told her to compose herself so that they could leave for Shan'dorah. Ailaya apologized to them for her recklessness.
Riftglaive Blackstar is a void elf located above the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. He is guarding Lady Darkglen.
Seigemaster Malenor is a blood elf located in the Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City. He is speaking with a Silvermoon Worker who appears to be working on a ballista.
Solwin Brightstitch is a blood elf located on the steps of Silvermoon Finery in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Temporal Beacon is a buff caused by the mage's Regeneration (mage rune) and Mass Regeneration abilities.

Vaultkeeper Elysa is a blood elf located next to the Great Vault in the Bank of Silvermoon in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. She is the Token of Merit exchange for , trading Thalassian Token of Merit from the Great Vault for other, hopefully more useful items.

Dun Argol is an iron dwarf city located in the Grizzly Hills of Northrend. The iron dwarves here are led by Iron Thane Furyhammer. Dun Argol became the capital of the iron dwarves after the fall of Thor Modan and its continued destruction by the stone giants. Explorers' League prospectors Gann, Torgan and Varana were sent to Dun Argol by Raegar Breakbrow to search for artifacts and information about the history of the settlement, however, they never expected Dun Argol to be this heavily populated and they were all taken captive by the iron dwarves. They were later rescued by adventurers. The brothers Bronzebeard made note of Dun Argol, stating that the city resembles the Northrend titanic st

Eleanor Rusk is a Forsaken general goods and drink vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. She was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity. After the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, Eleanor moved there.
Elisa Perry is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.

Emeline is a blood elf where she first appeared as Initiate Emeline in Silvermoon City and later in the Sanctum of Light as Archivist Emeline since the start of the third invasion of the Burning Legion.
Enchantress Fira is a blood elf located in the Court of the Sun in Silvermoon City.
Eral Broken is a general goods vendor located at the Lower City market in the neutral Shattrath City.
Eriden is a blood elf blacksmithing vendor located in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.
Ernie Packwell is a human trade goods vendor located in the Lower City in Shattrath City.

Erelyn Moonfang is a night elf found in the ruined village of Andu'talah in Val'sharah. The Highlord of the Silver Hand came to Erelyn while finding information about the Moonfang family's connection to the Burning Legion.

Fanala Bridkind is a human techno mage. A human who fled Dalaran when the Scourge came, she stowed away on a goblin merchant ship and found herself in Ratchet. Feelings about arcanists being at a low, she apprenticed herself with a tinker and used subtle magic to aid her when her tinkering abilities proved insufficient. Soon she was melding the two skillfully and caught the attention of Grimm Onearm. Her fireball-firing pistol, while being nearly as dangerous to the attacker as her target, impressed him sufficiently to appoint her in charge of the weaponsmithing of the House. She has lost only three fingers to her art, but wears the scars like badges, and enjoys showing off the weapons that
Faustron is an orc wind rider flight master located in the southwestern corner of Moonglade.
Fatigued Ritualist is a human briefly appearing in Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City protecting the traitor Melris Malagan.

Felicia Doan is a Forsaken general trade goods vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. She was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity. After the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, Felicia moved there.

Fennie Hornswaggle is a flight master at Lion's Landing and member of the Explorer's League. She carries out menial tasks for the Alliance forces and transports Alliance adventurers during several high-security missions. After Anduin was attacked by Garrosh for destroying the Bell at the Emperor's Reach, she was called by the adventurer to carry the injured Anduin back to the Landing. She was then seen in the keep, speaking with Sully "The Pickle" McLeary. During weeks when the Out of the Frying Pan questline is available, Fennie can be found at Brann Bronzebeard's camp in the Llothien Highlands in Azsuna.

Felyae is a dwarf who took Li Li and Chen Stormstouts on her wagon and carried them through Tanaris. She compared the tol'vir to centaurs as they are just big cats instead of horses. As the caravan entered Uldum, they stumbled upon a group of tol'vir who took them to the city of Ramkahen. After arriving to the city, the three witnessed King Phaoris' sentence over the remaining Nefersets. Felyae then explained the pandaren what the Curse of Flesh is.
Fereda is a Mag'har orc participating in Darkmoon Island's dance contest.

Finel is a night elf infant. When the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus began to collapse during the Burning of Teldrassil, Mia Greymane sheltered the child in her arms. When Genn Greymane arrived to rescue Mia, she urged him to take the child, but he instead took both of them back through the portal to Stormwind City, where Tyrande Whisperwind took the baby in her arms. Since Mia did not know the child's name, Tyrande named her "Finel" — Darnassian for "the last" — for she was the very last kaldorei to escape from Teldrassil with her life. When Tyrande was holding her, she wished that it was not the end of the night elves. She is first seen as a toddler walking the streets of the newly built
Nayeth Frostmoon is a night elf that would be located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City prior to the discovery of Pandaria.
Firodren Mooncaller is a night elf artisan herbalism trainer located outside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

Frostfathom is a venerable night elf weapon crafted by the legendary Moonguard, an elite fighting force in ancient times. This singular magical bow is a icy burst composite longbow. Queen Azshara herself imbued it with its icy burst quality, making it even deadlier for her favored agent to wield. It was wielded by Lady Vashj.
Furan is a blood elf located at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.
Galana is a blood elf located in Keelen's Trustworthy Tailoring in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Garn Mathers is a human located on an island at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh. He is a member of the Defias Brotherhood. He is the current leader of the Defias in Dustwallow Marsh. He and his gang reside on a large island just off the coast to the northeast of Sentry Point near a fairly large shipwreck. Killing him will retrieve any important documents containing information as to why the Defias are in the area.

Garamok is a Shattered Hand orc who recently worked with Malus and the Hidden to locate Captain Greydon Thorne. When Malus was about to leave, he noticed Throgg and asked him to come with him but refused stating he gave an oath. Malus thus went to speak with Garamok. Garamok said that the ogre can never be a true Shattered Hand but that he wanted to keep him for carrying supplies, so he wouldn't release him from the oath. Malus offered him 20 silver for the release. Garamok refused. Malus then offered 30 and the orc agreed. Hearing this, Throgg was furious.

General Zarithrian is a member of the Black dragonflight. He has lead an assault on the Ruby Sanctum in order to weaken the Red dragonflight in preparation for his master's return. He is surrounded by a wall of fire and cannot be reached until Saviana Ragefire and Baltharus the Warborn are dead.
Ghura is a Mag'har orc. Due to her affiliation, she might have been intended to be the shaman trainer for Silvermoon City.

Glacier Rot is a death knight talent located on tier 1 of the Frost tree. It causes enemies who are afflicted by any disease to take up to 20% additional damage from your frost-based abilities. Since you always want to keep Frost Fever up on any target you are fighting, this generally translates into a 20% damage increase for these abilities.

Goma is an orc located in The Broken Tusk in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he and some other inhabitants of the city were held captive by the Kor'kron. He was forced to follow Mojka into battle but apparently survived as he is still in Orgrimmar.
Gor'thul is an orc located at the Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak. His clothes and his blood magic abilities mark him as one of the Iron Blood Mages of the .
Gorrik is an orc flight master located at New Kargath in the Badlands. Gorrik also served as the flight master for the original Kargath prior to the Cataclysm.
Gort Goreflight is an orc flight master located at the Mor'shan Rampart in the Northern Barrens.

Granny Smith is a human fruit vendor located in the Lower City in Shattrath City. She accidentally left her cart right in front of 's tent; hence Threadstrong's constant proclaiming of death to the "fruit vendor" and the squashing of apples. However, Cro is unaware that his offending fruit vendor is actually Granny Smith. It was later revealed that Darmari has tried to explain this to Cro, but he stubbornly refused to believe her. She seems to be missing some apples, presumably from Threadstrong's crushing them, but she blames it on the nearby ogre. She later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore alongside members of the Uncrowned.
Grokom Deatheye is an orc weapon vendor located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
Grizzled Gladiator was an orc located in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City.

Koma is an orc grunt located in the Bank of Orgrimmar in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. Along with his brothers, Soran and Karus, Koma claims to have fought at the Battle of Mount Hyjal. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, he was speaking with Kixa.
Grutah is an orc master blacksmithing trainer located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Guthor was an orc warrior who accompanied Durotan on his assault on Telmor. After the battle was over, the Old Horde began to trash the city. Durotan quickly put a stop to the mayhem and ordered the city searched for supplies. He set up two groups to start on opposite ends and meet in the middle, one led by Orgrim, the other by Guthor. His status afterwards is unknown.

Hackle is a small gnoll warrior. He was exiled from the Woodpaw because he is runt of the litter and is not suited to be a brute. He was captured by the Gordunni clan and brought into Dire Maul to fight for ogre amusement. Aramar Thorne tried to befriend him but the gnoll said that he would kill him if they were matched together. So the boy tried to work his good magic with his sketchbook as well as showing him Cackle. The ogres indeed paired them in the match so they started fighting. Hackle, somewhat hesitantly. Aram tried running and use his book to fool the ogres. Hackle said that it is not a magic book, so King Gordok roared to kill the boy. Both of them ran for their weapons, yet Aram

Halfkan is the captain of a merchant crew, who were willing to smuggle Mathias Shaw and the imprisoned Sira Moonwarden from Dazar'alor to Stormwind City. He is noted for having a sour-face and red hair.
Doug Deepdown is a Dark Iron dwarf flight master located at Flamestar Post in the Burning Steppes.

Hardiness is a passive orc racial trait that reduces the duration of stun effects on the character. The ability is very powerful in Player vs. Player combat, and can be very useful for tanks as you cannot dodge or parry while stunned.
Harriet Mura is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. She is found standing with Anna Taki.

High Invoker Basaleph is a human member of the Cult of the Damned. He appears in the Cathedral of Darkness during the quest Tirion's Gambit. During this quest, Arthas' Frozen Heart is delivered to him in order to be safeguarded. Tirion Fordring intervenes, and destroys the heart after realizing that there is no chance of redeeming Arthas. The explosion caused by destroying the heart wounds Tirion and the Lich King, and kills High Invoker Basaleph.
Hiumi Togo is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.

Holy Concentration was a Tier 3 Holy priest talent that increased passive mana regeneration while in combat. Upon choosing the Holy (or Discipline) tree, priests gain Meditation, making their base mana regeneration in combat 50%. This talent added an additional 15/30%. It was a pre-requisite for Chakra.

Houndmaster Shaw is a human featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. Shaw is one of King Genn Greymane's finest thieftakers, and has been tasked by the king to investigate the rumors of the doomsaying "Crowskin" cult. A renowned hunter of criminal, beast, and monster, the man known as Houndmaster Shaw has humble roots. In fact, he is he is rumored to have been raised by a pack of hounds on the streets of Gilneas City. While that story is of dubious provenance, Shaw has an almost supernatural way with the animals in his care, and he ascended from the gutters into the king's service as a thieftaker and master of hounds — all on his own merits. While Shaw doesn't get on nearly a

Imperator Hok'lon was the sorcerer king of the Gorian Empire roughly 100 years before the opening of the Dark Portal. Outraged by the newly arrived draenei's construction of Shattrath City atop the ruins of the ancient ogre city of Goria, he led a brief and entirely unsuccessful campaign to reclaim the area and died in the attempt.

Indus was a gnomish member of the Council of Tirisfal 2,600 years ago. She preceded Erbag as one of the first gnomes recorded in history. 2,600 years before the First War, she was the group's gnomish representative in her day. Not only was she a respected, powerful mage, but following her people's penchant for tinkering, she was also known as "the inventor" in Dalaran. She was an associate of founding council member Meryl Winterstorm. She, Meryl, and the rest of the surviving council would empower the first Guardian of Tirisfal, an orphaned half-elf and talented mage named Alodi. One of the machines she used may very well have been the first hot air balloon.

Innkeeper Allison is a human innkeeper who owns and runs the Gilded Rose Inn in Stormwind City's Trade District, between the bank and the auction house. She can be found just inside the inn on the ground floor. She was present and seen in the auction house when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Innkeeper Gryshka is an orc innkeeper located in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. She has an affinity for meat. After the betrayal of Varimathras and Putress, Sylvanas and Forsaken refugees had to escape to Orgrimmar. During that time Orgrimmar was under martial law and Gryshka was complaining about the situation along with other citizens. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, she could be seen behind the bar selling goods alongside Barkeep Morag. After the failed Broken Shore attack, she was standing in front of the entrance of the inn. She was then present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Innkeeper Jovia is a blood elf innkeeper located in Wayfarer's Rest Inn between the Walk of Elders and the Bazaar within the capital of Silvermoon City.

Inkmaster Solia is a blood elven member of the Kabal, one of the three crime families active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. Solia is the one responsible for creating the distinctive magical tattoos worn by members of the Kabal, which not only marks one's dedication to the organization, but can also serve as a handy nightlight or a massive reservoir of power in a pinch. She apparently also runs a business by the name of "Inkmaster Solia's Tattoos" on "1818 Gadgetzan Way".
Jack Trapper is a human journeyman cooking trainer located at the Lower City market in the neutral Shattrath City.

Iyseelar Dewsong was a night elf Ashen druid located in Val'sharah. He was one of Delandros Shimmermoon's three most trusted Ashen, charged with carrying one of the Tel'andu Seeds that could renew the magical barriers protecting the Fangs of Ashamane. He was slain in Val'sharah by demons during the Third invasion of the Burning Legion, but the seed was fortunately found on his corpse by a druid adventurer and brought to the Ashen leader.

Jarlath Brewbelly is a bronzebeard dwarf paladin and a member of the Alliance. He wields a masterwork dwarven battle hammer and a heavy steel shield, and wears plate mail. He knows aura of might, and holy strike. He is known for his toughness. He was once hired by Molus Blackburn (who had been in disguise) to break into the lair of the necromancer Toren Snapjoint and destroy him. He was hired along with fellow Alliance members, including Widge Whistlevalve, Botrek Pahno, Cerise Moonrain, Maith'hal, and Yinny. After battling Toren, his acolytes, and his undead servants in the necromancer's cave, Molus entered the cave no longer disguised and with some hired muscle. He attacked the weakened he

James Meier is a human attending Shauna Strattonmeier's storytime session in the Royal Library in Stormwind City alongside Jordan Meier and four Attentive Children. He will occasionally summon magical fireworks or a projection of a rabbit to entertain the children.
Jim Saltit is a human cooking vendor located in the Lower City in Shattrath City.

Warlord Jin'zakk is the ruler of the kingdom of Zul'Aman. While witch doctors control Zul'Aman, with shamans and warchiefs in lesser leadership positions, Jin'zakk is the exception to this tradition ruling the entire kingdom. He commands the trolls, and his witch doctors and shamans provide magic support. Jin'zakk is a massive, aged forest troll with gray fur (once green, apparently) and huge natural claws. Grizzled and old, he can still savage any troll who would dispute his rule. Jin'zakk's age brings wisdom and certainty, though the warlord is unstable and prone to violent rages. He practices voodoo, and his dark art empowers him.
Jenna Redwell is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. She is found walking with Jo Weaver.

Jorgen is a human located in the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City. He can be found down by the water, to the right when entering through the city's main gates. He apparently has some kind of "history" with Elling Trias.

Jon Casper is a human cooking vendor located in the Canal District of the city of Stormwind. He is one of the city's foremost chefs, alongside Robby Flay, and is responsible for awarding rare cooking recipes to those cooks who have proven themselves skilled enough. He can be found standing in a square just south of the Stormwind Stockade, beside Robby Flay.
Joiya Reed is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. She is found standing with Mari Reed.
Jo Weaver is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. She is found walking with Jenna Redwell.

Kandrostrasz is a member of the Brood of Alexstrasza inside the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj who gives adventurers high level boots and pants for turning in special loot items to him. Andorgos gives adventurers helms and shoulders while Vethsera gives chest items. The three are located just past The Prophet Skeram. Kandrostrasz, along with Andorgos and Vethsera, came to the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj after sensing their enslaved brethren deep inside the Qiraji city. However they are unable to attempt to rescue their flightmembers without also falling prey to the same spell which holds Caelestrasz, Arygos, and Merithra as C'Thun's slaves. The three wait at the entrance of the temple hoping to find adventurer

Wavebinder Kardris Dreamseeker was an orc shaman trainer located outside of Miwana's Longhouse in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar. Before the Shattering, she was located in Grommash Hold. At the time of the Darkspear Rebellion, she moved in the Valley of Strength, where she only taught dark shaman. Terga Earthbreaker replaced her.

Karnitol is a human mage and "noble of some sort" who lives in Stormwind City. His ship, carrying a valuable chest, was attacked by sea giants off the coast of Desolace. He and his servants tried to bring the chest ashore, but when more giants attacked, Karnitol chose to abandon it and teleport himself and his servants to safety. He subsequently hired Reclaimers Inc. to find the chest and return it to him. The chest's contents had been stolen by the Slitherblade naga, but adventurers helped Kreldig Ungor retrieve them and then brought them in a satchel to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge so he could deliver them to Karnitol.

Keldric Boucher is a human alchemist and alchemy supplies and reagents vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found behind the counter inside the shop Pestle's Apothecary, along with Kyra Boucher and Morgan Pestle. He was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind.
Keeli is a blood elf mail armor vendor located in Shields of Silver in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Kayvon Quinnstar is a night elf located at Warspear in Ashran. He is a recruiter of the Alliance war effort in Ashran. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion Quinnstar moved to the eastern entrance of the Underbelly Descent in Dalaran.
Keyanomir is a blood elf located in the Murder Row or in the Sanctum, standing in the corner near a bookshelf, in Silvermoon City. He is accompanied by his succubus minion, Nimrida.
Kevin Browning is a human drink vendor located in the Lower City section of Shattrath City.
Khan Nabul is an orc vendor located in front of the Cauldron of Rock cave on the Darkmoon Island.

Knight-Lord Bloodvalor is a blood elf paladin located in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City. A member of the order of Blood Knights, he is in charge of managing the rank-and-file paladins, typically overseeing their first and second main trials. Blood Knights that were to train as Masters received summons from Lord Solanar Bloodwrath (and Lady Liadrin herself before him) instead.
Knight-Lieutenant Moonstrike was a night elf vendor that sold PvP gear. He could be found in the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City.

Klaxxi'va Pok was a member of the Klaxxi when Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver was first born into the swarm. Kil'ruk would come to Klaxxi'va Pok's attention when he began showing innovations such as having flyers dive into battle, wielding swords. When Klaxxi'va Pok went to speak with the Wind-Reaver, he was disappointed that Kil'ruk could not put aside the empress's commands. After a mogu relic cut the mantid swarm off from the voice of their empress, the Klaxxi made the decision to awaken Ninil'ko the Bloodcaller to aid and decided that Kil'ruk should be one to do so to ensure he's drawn out of his depression. With the tactics and guidance of the Bloodcaller, the mogu and the relic were destroyed,
Kradu Grimblade is a Mag'har orc blacksmithing trainer located in the Lower City in Shattrath City.
Korthul is an orc bow and gun vendor located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Korgol Crushskull is a Mag'har orc standing outside the Deathmatch Pavilion in Darkmoon Island. Every three hours he will announce when players are able to fight one another within the pavilion in order to obtain the Pit Fighter, he will also announce the survivor of the battle.

Kral'za is a young orc with the Shadowmoon Exiles. He fell in love with Dol'mak, who embraced the void magic used by the rest of the , and ran away with her when his mother did not approve. Dol'mak tried to sacrifice him to the , but he was rescued by adventurers hired by his mother. The experience taught Kral'za that the rest of the clan could no longer be trusted.

Krukk is an orc Warsong Gulch battlemaster located at Farstriders' Square in the blood elven capital of Silvermoon City during the Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch).
Krek Cragcrush is an orc blacksmithing vendor located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
