Kros is a god that the Skumblade tribe of saurok worship. The Skumblade Saur-Priests promote the idea that the saurok were not created by the mogu, but instead evolved from their creator Kros, the invisible devilsaur in the sky. The Echo of Kros can be summoned and defeated, showing that Kros is very real. In addition, the Skumblade Brutes can invoke the strength of Kros, showing it has the power to bless its faithful. Kroshik is held to be a gift from Kros and a glimpse at the Skumblade's future. According to the saurok who worship Kroshik only do so because they are scared.

Krull is a dire orc who was going to assist the Iron Horde in the taking of Karabor. However, this only happens if the Dark Star is not stopped and is not seen during the siege. It's possible he was present, but as the player arrives sometime after the defense crystal is destroyed and the vision shows before he was simply already dealt with.

Kyra Boucher is a human reagent vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found just inside the shop Pestle's Apothecary, along with Keldric Boucher and Morgan Pestle. She was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city. She appears in the Vision of Stormwind.

Kyranastrasz was a powerful red dragon who fought a mysterious darkness on the Lost Glacier many years ago. He fell in battle and only the rest of his flight knew of his fate. It wasn't until the third invasion of the Burning Legion that the Lich King saw a vision of undead north of Icecrown being drawn to the dragon's remains. After locating the glacier, the Lich King sent the Deathlord of the Ebon Blade to raise Kyranastrasz into undeath.

Lakeshire (or Lakewood) is a human town that sits on the banks of the majestic and large Lake Everstill. It is located in the Redridge Mountains, and its citizens are under the watchful and often worried eye of elected Magistrate Solomon. Recently, after many years, the bridge to Lakeshire was finally repaired. Marshal Marris of the Stormwind Guard is in charge of the security of town and its surrounding areas. Redridge is classified as a contested zone but contains no Horde flight point or quests. However, it is a very short ride away from the Burning Steppes, a high-level zone, and thus many Horde players choose to engage in raids there.

Lee Crester is a human banker located in the Royal Bank of Stormwind in the Dwarven District of the human city of Stormwind City. His relatives Curtis and Jamie also work as bankers in the same building.

Lhara is an orc exotic goods vendor located in the Darkmoon Faire camp, which is only available during Darkmoon Faire event. She sells a selection of limited quantity items. Many of the trade items that she sells, such as Arctic Fur, various motes and some rare herbs like Ancient Lichen to name just a few, cost significantly less than the going rate for the same goods in the auction houses. It's not unusual to see players camping out around her to wait for respawn of these limited quantity items. Fortunately the item respawn timer appears to be relatively short so you are not likely to be disappointed as long as you have the patience to wait a little while when you visit her.

Lieutenant Orrin was a human member of the Argent Dawn, stationed in Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City next to during the duration of the Scourge Invasion. He sent low-level adventurers on a trip outside the city to investigate the invading Scourge.
Lieutenant Asalra is a human found at the Shattered Beachhead of Shattershore in Blasted Lands. She is seen leading the defense of the beachhead.

Liftbrul was the greatest of all drogbar weightlifters and a champion of the Stonedark tribe. He was immortalized in stone (literally) by chief Rynox, the second-strongest drogbar of his time, and to this day Liftbrul's statue remains in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain. He also has a statue at Glimmerogg in Zaralek Cavern.

Lillian Singh is a human Holiday Fireworks Vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City during the Midsummer Fire Festival and Peon Day (see Notes section). She is probably related to Darian Singh, a year-round fireworks vendor located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City.
Limbflayer Lasha is a Mag'har orc that briefly appears in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

Lisbeth Schneider is a human cloth armor vendor located in the Canals, along the edge of the Trade District, in Stormwind City. She can be found behind the counter inside the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, just west of the bridge to the Cathedral Square. She was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city. She appears dead in the Vision of Stormwind, having her eyes and mouth sewn shut.

Llaran is a night elf of the Sentinels. She has pale, violet eyes and is a little shorter than her brother, Iyneath. She has a moonsaber. The two took down a black drake who held Makasa Flintwill in its claws in the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Sentinels took Makasa and her friends to a camp to recuperate and, alongside Aiyell, offered them to take them to Thal'darah Overlook. As they were going, she was speaking with Aramar Thorne about their journey. She and the other Sentinels later watched the departure of Makasa and her friends on the Cloudkicker.

Lord Afrasastrasz is a red dragon in human guise located at the Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight, where he serves as its highest military leader. He led the defenses against the blue dragonflight assault and later against Deathwing's forces. He is an outspoken supporter of Alexstrasza. He was also present at the meeting in the Wyrmrest Temple before and after the death of Deathwing. He seemed to sympathize with Kalecgos wishing to keep the Wyrmrest Accord united, but did not speak up when the other Dragon Aspects proposed disbanding the organization. The Power of the Aspects buff can be disabled by talking to Lord Afrasastrasz at the beginning of Dragon Soul if a raid wishes to attempt th

Lordain was the leader of an unnamed human tribe from the Tirisfal Glades, and a prominent general of the Arathorian Empire during the Troll Wars. During the war, he sacrificed himself to hold off a large force of Amani trolls that threatened to destroy the Arathorian host. The region (and later the city and kingdom) of Lordaeron was named in his honor.
Lordaeron Mage is a human located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City and in the Undercity.

Lord Devrestrasz is a red dragon in human guise located at the Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight, where he serves as its highest military leader. He led the defenses against the blue dragonflight assault and later against Deathwing's forces. He is an outspoken supporter of Alexstrasza. The Power of the Aspects buff can be disabled by talking to Lord Devrestrasz at the beginning of Dragon Soul if a raid wishes to attempt the encounters without the aid of the Dragon Aspects.

Lucas Severing is a human paladin located in front of the fountain, on the grounds of Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City. He is standing beside his acquaintance and fellow paladin, Naanae, whom he converses with. When Aysa Cloudsinger, Jojo Ironbrow, and the pandaren adventurer came to Stormwind Keep to meet King Varian Wrynn, Lucas asked Naanae to be quiet when they arrived, and remarked that the Light was strong with the adventurer. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, while the city was under lockdown because of the infiltration from the Veiled Hand, Lucas was tasked by Mathias Shaw to guard the gate into the Stormwind Keep section. Although he threw a holy mace onto the drawbri

Lylandor was a night elf Warsong Gulch battlemaster located in the Lower City of the neutral Shattrath City during the Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch. He didn't speak much, and replied only with "Mmm". He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch).

Lyrlia Blackshield is a blood elf Eye of the Storm battlemaster located in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm. Her aggro was linked with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, and would assist her alongside fellow battlemasters Deathstalker Fane and Misery if the Undercity came under attack.
Lyra Fairwind is the mother of Flynn Fairwind She was hanged for being a thief when Flynn was just a boy.

Magus Tirth is a human mage. Before the Cataclysm, he was a chicken vendor located at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. He wrote the book Rituals of Power, but sold it due to gambling debts to a member of the Scarlet Crusade. Magus spends his time trying to torture "Plucky". His inability to stop the Cataclysm from flooding the Thousand Needles has caused him to go insane and become Mad Magus Tirth. He has recaptured "Plucky" Johnson, and placed the blame of the Cataclysm on his former apprentice. They are both located in Tirth's Haunt. Adventurers of the Horde and Alliance killed him and extracted his soul which was used to bring back Tony Two-Tusk.

Madrigosa is a female blue dragon flying above Brutallus in the Dead Scar, visible from both the Isle of Quel'Danas and within the Sunwell Plateau. She came to the island with Kalecgos in order to defend Anveena from Kil'jaeden and the rest of the Burning Legion, though the two became separated within the Plateau. Inside the raid, when players approach the Den of Iniquity, a room overlooking the Dead Scar, Madrigosa blocks their way with a wall of ice and does battle with Brutallus, demanding answers about Anveena and Kalecgos, only to be killed by the pit lord. When the raid defeats Brutallus, his blood seeps into the ground and flows beneath her body, dissolving her flesh and raising her s

Mage-Commander Lyra is a human located in the Stormwind Stockade. She locked it down and surrounded Rokhan, Talanji, and the Horde adventurer when they were freeing Princess Talanji and Prophet Zul. She used her magic to block their way and eventually teleported to a room where she was struck down by the Horde.
Madelia Bruder is a blood elf located in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.
Magistrix Caradess was a blood elf battlemaster for Wintergrasp in Silvermoon City.
Magister Yisanan is a high elf archmage who defended Silvermoon City when the death knight Arthas Menethil invaded Quel'Thalas.
Magister Senithir is a high elf archmage who defended Silvermoon City when the death knight Arthas Menethil invaded Quel'Thalas.
Magister Ainetu is a high elf archmage who defended Silvermoon City when the death knight Arthas Menethil invaded Quel'Thalas.
Magister Cillias is a high elf archmage who defended Silvermoon City when the death knight Arthas Menethil invaded Quel'Thalas.

Major Samuelson is a human located in the throne room of Stormwind Keep, in the city of Stormwind. He is a member of the Stormwind City Guard, and was the mentor of Lieutenant Farren Orinelle. He served as captain of the guard until the events of the Cataclysm.

Manoc was a flying machine pilot who helped defend Stormwind City against the Scourge attack. It is unknown what happened to him afterwards, and which race he is, although it is likely he is a gnome or a goblin.

Mannethrel Darkstar is a night elf located at Molten Shore on Mardum. He is rescued from imprisonment by a demon hunter and makes his way to Illidari Foothold, remarking that he almost lost his fight against the fel energy inside of him. While Mannethrel was recuperating at the foothold, his rescuer later attempted to teach him what they had learned from the Tome of Fel Secrets (item) -- only to end disastrously when Mannethrel failed to contain the power and exploded in a burst of fel energy.
Mari Reed is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. She is found standing with Joiya Reed.

Mazen Mac'Nadir is a human mage located in the Canals (Mage Quarter section) of the human city of Stormwind. Mazen is a member of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences, and is responsible for the care taking of the academy library's magical tomes. He can be found inside the library of the academy, which is located just south of the Stormwind Stockade building in the Canal District, and is assisted in his tasks by his assistant, Dellis.

Melris Malagan is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He is in charge of the guards in the city and can be found in the central square of the Trade District, beside the Hero's Call Board. Every now and then Stormwind Gryphon Riders come and report to him.

Melaya Tassier is a blood elf located in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. She is a part of the crowd listening to the arguments of Lyria Skystrider and Priest Ennas against the decision of the blood elven leaders to join with the Horde. She counters them with statements supporting these decisions.

Mereldar was the sister of General Lordain and originally a renowned warrior in the united human army during the Troll Wars. She was among the soldiers saved when her brother selflessly sacrificed himself to hold off an overwhelming force of Amani trolls. When the war ended, Mereldar dedicated her life to caring for humanity's wounded veterans. It was she who first spoke to other humans about visions of the Light. In her dreams, Mereldar saw five strange, inhuman forms thrumming with holy power that filled her mind with the wisdom of holiness, protection, justice, retribution, and compassion. When she put their wordless teachings into practice, power seemed to flow through her, miraculously

Meryl Felstorm (previously known as Meryl Winterstorm) is an ancient undead human sorcerer. He is an incredibly powerful magic user, with nearly three thousand years of experience, whose purpose has always been the protection of Azeroth. He was a founding member of the Council of Tirisfal, and is the foster father and mentor of Med'an, Garona Halforcen's son.

Merchant Felagunne was a general goods vendor onboard the Feathermoon Ferry, the boat that runs between Feathermoon Stronghold and The Forgotten Coast. He sold anything you could possibly need, and also repaired gear.
Mirvedon is a blood elf located in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.

Molus Blackburn was an ambitious and cruel Dark Iron dwarf who began making efforts to serve the Burning Legion. He hoped the demons would be pleased and reward him with greater power. To that end, sought to establish a secret base near Ironforge to further the Legion's goals. He used magic to disguise himself as a Bronzebeard dwarf and headed to Khaz Modan to search for an appropriate spot. After a few days, he discovered a cave that was perfect for his purposes.
